tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Official identity. Used as text on `.stat-value`, `.table-link`, `.footer-link`; border on `.tracker-step.active`. 10.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Maximum readability. Used as text on `.header`, `.service-action`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Status confirmation. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.service-status.active`, `.table-badge.approved`; border on `.tracker-step.completed`. 5.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success-light
tokens.usage: Success state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-alert
tokens.usage: Critical notifications. Used as border on `.notification-banner.alert`; text on `.service-status.pending`, `.table-badge.pending`. 5.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-alert-light
tokens.usage: Error / danger state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Optimal contrast. Used as text on `body`, `.notification-title`, `.section-title`. 17.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: table-link-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.service-action:focus`, `.table-link:focus`, `.footer-link:focus`; background on `.table-link:focus`, `.footer-link:focus`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
